Controls server tick rate during the Time Warp. Default: 50. Vanilla: 20. Recommended safe ceiling on a normal system: 100. Beyond 200, expect server lag, disconnects, or crashes — this is your call. Tip: Set both Engine TPS and Virtual TPS to the same number for a truly real-time night — the night will pass at exactly 1:1 real speed.
gamerule.minecraft.truesleep_virtual_tps: How many game-ticks pass per real second during sleep. Default: 1000 (~50x faster than vanilla night). Recommended ceiling on a normal system: ~20000 (night passes in roughly 1 real second). Higher values have no practical benefit — the warp still ends at Wake Time. Tip: Set both Virtual TPS and Engine TPS to the same number for a truly real-time night — no time dilation, just real speed.
gamerule.minecraft.truesleep_sleep_thres: The time of day (in ticks, 0-23999) when players are allowed to start sleeping. Vanilla default is dusk (~12542). Lowering this allows sleeping earlier in the day.
gamerule.minecraft.truesleep_wake_time.d: The time of day (0-23999) when the Time Warp stops and players wake. Reference: 0=Dawn, 1000=Early Morning, 6000=Noon, 12000=Dusk, 13000=Night, 18000=Midnight, 23000=Pre-Dawn. Note: A full day is 24000 ticks — 24000 equals 0 (Dawn) and is not a valid target.
gamerule.minecraft.truesleep_drown_immun: Safety Protocol: If enabled, grants temporary water-breathing to all entities during the Time Warp. Prevents players and mobs from drowning due to the accelerated passage of time while swimming.
gamerule.minecraft.truesleep_freeze_mobs: Stasis Field: If enabled, completely freezes all non-worker mobs during the Time Warp. Prevents pathfinding lag, metabolic death, and chaotic movement. Allows the engine to focus on Redstone and Furnace simulation.
gamerule.minecraft.truesleep_freeze_work: Controls whether worker mobs (Villagers, Allays) are also frozen during the Time Warp. Default: false (workers continue operating). Enable to freeze all mobs including workers for maximum performance.
